summary: This bug-fix recipe orders deterministic validation into a causal red/green proof and hands the result to automated and human review.

items.text: Executable Safety Net provides the runnable checks; Reproduce–Patch–Prove orders them around one defect and requires a demonstrated red baseline.
Store the baseline failure, patch identity, passing reproducer and wider regression results as one linked evidence envelope.
Give quality-gate agents the deterministic red/green proof before asking for a semantic verdict on the repair.
Fire, Track, Review presents the minimal patch and its proof bundle instead of an unsupported success summary.
